arguments.summary: A suspicious configuration change was detected on the perimeter firewall (fw-perimeter) during an approved maintenance window. An unexpected ACL rule allowing inbound traffic on port 4444 triggered an alert. No evidence of data exfiltration or post-exploitation activity was found.

arguments.rule_content:
title: Lateral Movement - Pass the Hash to Critical Firewall
id: 5c3a7f8e-1b2d-4f1c-9d3e-5a4b6c7d8e9f
description: Detects NTLM authentication from non-service hosts to critical firewalls using service accounts.
status: experimental
author: SOC Team
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1075/
logsource:
    category: authentication
    product: windows
    service: security
detection:
    selection:
        EventID: 4624
        LogonType: 3
        AuthenticationPackageName: NTLM
        TargetServerName|endswith: '.firewall.corp.local'
        TargetUserName|contains: 'svc_'
        SourceHostName|notmatch: 'RT-*'
        SourceHostName|notmatch: 'REDTEAM-*'
    condition: selection
level: high
falsepositives:
    - Authorized penetration testing
    - Legitimate administrative activity from non-standard hosts
    - Red Team exercises

# Improvement: Added exclusion for Red Team host naming conventions
